lines.b: Lord You are my refuge
Your love took a hold of me
I am awaken in Your love
I long to be, Your dwelling place
I commit to love You
With firm determination to love You
To come close to You

lines.a: 主我願讓祢來擁有我的心
lines.b: Lord I long for You to come to overtake my heart

lines.a: 不再用力堅持倚靠我自己
lines.b: No longer determined to rely on myself
Let Your every word
Become my purpose

lines.a: 改變我生命一步一步與祢更靠近
lines.b: To transform for my life step by step closer to You

There is none like You
Your love satisfy my heart
You are my all in all
